steps.title: Gateway token exchange
steps.what: The gateway swaps the caller's verified token (RFC 8693) for one minted specifically for the downstream MCP server, so the backend validates a token issued to it rather than trusting a shared service account.
steps.why: The deck gives no separate problem statement for this row.
